evidence.title: RACO: Reliability-Aware Coarse-Goal Optimization for Inspection-Oriented UAV Vision-Language Navigation

summary: A new study presents RACO, a reliability-aware optimization method designed to improve inspection-oriented navigation for drones using vision-language models. The approach aims to enhance accuracy and efficiency in autonomous UAV missions.
title: Researchers Introduce RACO: A New AI Framework for UAV Vision-Language Navigation
